title: Engineers make quality, low-cost carbon fiber from coproducts of paper, energy production
summary_en: Iowa State researchers are taking their innovations for producing high-performance, high-value biobased carbon fiber from batch production in a lab to commercially relevant continuous production.
title_cn: Engineers make quality, low-cost carbon fiber from coproducts of paper, energy production

title: When Wall Street (almost) never sleeps
summary_en: Wall Street is preparing to stay awake longer. As major exchanges move toward a 23-hours-a-day, five-days-a-week trading schedule, Iowa State finance researcher Bidisha Chakrabarty discusses the shift to expanded trading hours, why it's happening, and the opportunities, risks and realities behind an always-on market.

title: Borlaug lecture features researcher’s success expanding nutrition sources in Africa
summary_en: Afokpe, a plant breeder and product specialist at East-West Seed International based in Benin, West Africa, discuss her work developing climate-resistant vegetables that have improved food and nutrition security across the region.
title_cn: Borlaug lecture features researcher’s success expanding nutrition sources in Africa
